title: Fujitsu Overhauls Financial DX Suite, Targets JPY 200bn in Revenue by 2030
tags: Fujitsu and Mizuho Target SME Efficiency Crisis with Automated Payment and Data PlatformFujitsu and Mizuho Bank have entered into a strategic collaboration aimed at overhauling the fragmented infrastructure of business-to-business (B2B) transactions in Japan. The partnership seeks to introduce a new order and payment processing service designed to streamline operations for Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (SMEs), aimed at cutting manual administrative workloadsJapan FinTech ObserverNorbert Gehrke
